scoring_justification: Efficiency recomputed from reported total_displacements using Kinchin‑Pease formula; cascade lifetime and cluster size checked against paper thresholds; monotonicity of efficiency verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: thresholds and reference values for cascade lifetime (1 ps, 0.1 ps), defect production efficiency at 0.25 keV (1.0) and 30 keV (0.37), C‑to‑Si ratio range [3,7], and maximum cluster size bound (3)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Fig. 1 (lifetime ~0.1 ps), text "less than 1 ps"; Fig. 5 (efficiency 1 at 0.25 keV, 0.37 at 30 keV); text "ratio … about 5"; text "no interstitial cluster containing more than three interstitials"
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly extracted from paper statements; tolerances added to absorb MD toolchain variation (different potential variant, LAMMPS version, statistical noise from finite cascades)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: every hidden gold value is a paper‑reported result for the same quantity, conditions, and units

schema.description: A single non‑negative number (float) representing the cascade lifetime in picoseconds for a 10 keV Si PKA in 3C‑SiC.

outputs.description: Cascade lifetime determined from the mean‑square displacement relaxation time. A smaller lifetime indicates faster relaxation; the value must be less than or equal to a hidden gold threshold.

Per‑damage‑energy summary of total displacements, defect production efficiency, anti‑site defect fraction, and for 10 keV the C‑to‑Si interstitial ratio. The checker recomputes efficiency from total_displacements, checks monotonicity, anti‑site fraction range, and closeness to hidden references.

schema.description: A single non‑negative integer: the maximum number of interstitials in any cluster observed across all cascades. A smaller value indicates less clustering.

outputs.description: Maximum interstitial cluster size. The value must be less than or equal to a hidden threshold (the paper's reported upper bound).

output_contract.notes: All energies listed must be simulated; omitting any under‑scopes the task. The anti_site_fraction is now reported for every energy; the verifier checks it lies within the paper's expected range and that efficiency values are monotonically decreasing.
